name: Email Notification
description: Sends an email notification when Claude completes a task, using a configurable SMTP relay or local sendmail
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send email notification on task completion
EMAIL_TO="${CLAUDE_NOTIFY_EMAIL:-}"
if [[ -z "$EMAIL_TO" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
SUBJECT="Claude Code: Task completed in $PROJECT"
MESSAGE="${NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE:-Claude Code has completed a task in $PROJECT.}"
# Try sendmail first, then curl with mailgun/sendgrid
if command -v sendmail &>/dev/null; then
  echo -e "Subject: $SUBJECT\n\n$MESSAGE" | sendmail "$EMAIL_TO" 2>/dev/null
elif [[ -n "$SENDGRID_API_KEY" ]]; then
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SENDGRID_API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"personalizations\":[{\"to\":[{\"email\":\"$EMAIL_TO\"}]}],\"from\":{\"email\":\"claude@localhost\"},\"subject\":\"$SUBJECT\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text/plain\",\"value\":\"$MESSAGE\"}]}" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
exit 0
